title: OpenAI ships the Agents SDK with guardrails, handoffs and tracing as built-in primitives
summary: OpenAI launched the Responses API, with built-in web search, local file search and computer control, and an Agents SDK for orchestrating agentic workflows that supersedes its experimental orchestration agent Swarm and works with any Chat Completions-style API. The SDK defines distinct agents, manages control transfer between them (handoffs), defines safety checks on input and output to prevent irrelevant, harmful or undesirable behaviour (guardrails), and visualises traces so developers can observe agents (tracing).
